tech.summary: Anthropic ne Claude Meetings beta launch kar diya: Claude ab Google Meet call mein aik visible participant ki tarah shamil hoga, baat-cheet sun kar notes, action items, docs aur whiteboards meeting ke dauran hi bana dega. Beta sirf Team aur Enterprise plans par hai, aur sirf Google Meet par — Zoom/Teams ka support 'coming soon'. Audio save nahi hota, sirf transcript aur screen descriptions rakhi jati hain, aur bahari guest aate hi Claude call se nikal jata hai.
tech.title: Claude ab aapki meeting mein bhi — Google Meet par live kaam karega

tech.summary: Cursor ne 13 November ki update mein bataya ke us ka October security incident Fireworks AI se shuru hua: aik access key jo Cursor ne Fireworks ko di thi, expose ho gayi. Attacker ne coding-agent traces copy kiye, un mein se kuch mein unredacted credentials mile, aur 29 October ko Anthropic ke Claude Code extension ke malicious versions (2.1.312 aur 2.1.313) Cursor ke marketplace cache mein daal diye — takreeban 11 ghante tak, zyada se zyada 5,000 users tak pohunche. Extension SSH backdoor lagane ki koshish karta tha. Cursor ne inference Fireworks se hata liya hai aur key revoke kar di.
tech.title: Cursor ka security incident — Fireworks se leak hui key, 5,000 users tak fake Claude Code extension

tech.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent ne CNBC par khul kar kaha ke Commerce Department ne months tak Megaspeed ko export blacklist mein daalne mein takheer ki — jab ke Treasury, Pentagon, USTR aur State sab is ke haq mein the. Megaspeed ne $4 billion se zyada ke Nvidia chips khareede, aur Bloomberg ke mutabiq banned H800/H100/H200 chips Shanghai ke aik AI data centre mein mile. Congress ab Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick ko testimony ke liye bula rahi hai, aur Huang ko bhi hearings ke liye talab kiye jane ka imkaan hai.
tech.title: Nvidia scandal ab cabinet fight — Bessent ne Lutnick par 'chips China ko' ka ilzam lagaya

tech.summary: Anthropic ka Claude Fable 5.2 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index par 65 points ke saath number 1 ban gaya — Gemini 4 Carbon (60), Claude Opus 5.5 (59) aur OpenAI ke GPT-6 Astra (57) se aage. Model 9 November ko launch hua, Fable 5.1 se 20% sasta hai ($8 input / $40 output per million tokens) aur 30% tez output ka dawa hai. Ussi hafte OpenAI ne apna GPT-6 Cyber model sirf vetted security customers tak mehdood rakha — testing mein us ne Firefox mein 81 pehle se unknown high-severity flaws dhoondhe.
tech.title: Claude Fable 5.2 AI rankings mein number 1 — Gemini aur GPT-6 ko peeche chhoda

tech.summary: Ex-OpenAI researcher Will DePue ki forensic report ke mutabiq DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax aur Ant Group ke 6 naye open-weight models — jin mein DeepSeek-V4-Pro, Kimi K3 aur MiniMax-M3 shamil hain — Nvidia ke export-controlled Blackwell GPUs par initialize hue. Har GPU aur seed ka aik unique pattern hota hai jo trained weights mein bach jata hai; DePue ne 6 trillion se zyada combinations check kiye. Report khud kehti hai ye kisi qanoon ki khilaf-warzi ka saboot nahi — chips China se bahar rent par bhi liye ja sakte hain — lekin export-control regime mein aik bara gap dikhata hai.
tech.title: Chinese AI models mein banned Nvidia Blackwell chips ke fingerprints mile

pakistan.summary: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi ke naye subon par referendum ki tajweez ke baad, President Asif Ali Zardari aur PM Shehbaz Sharif ne Lahore mein Model Town residence par mulaqat ki. PM Office ke mutabiq overall siyasi, maashi aur security surat-e-haal par baat hui; Shehbaz ne Turkiye ke daure aur COP31 mein shirkat par bhi briefing di. Senator Saleem Mandviwalla ke mutabiq mulaqat mein cheeni ki qeematein aur gandum ki import bhi zair-e-bahas aayi. Dono parties ne kaha naye sube aain ke mutabiq sirf subai assemblies ki qarardad se ban sakte hain.
pakistan.title: Zardari–Shehbaz ki Lahore mulaqat — naye subon par referendum ki bahas tez

pakistan.summary: Economic Cooperation Organisation (ECO) ki Council of Ministers ka 30th ijlas aaj aur kal Islamabad mein ho raha hai, Deputy PM aur Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar ki sadarat mein. Pakistan 2026-27 ke liye ECO ki chairmanship rakh raha hai aur 'Reviving Regionalism for a Resilient ECO' ke theme par regional trade, connectivity aur integration par zor de raha hai. Iran ke wazeer-e-kharja Abbas Araghchi khususi mehman hain, jab ke Afghanistan ke wazeer-e-kharja ko dawat nahi di gayi.
pakistan.title: Islamabad mein aaj ECO wuzra-e-kharja ijlas — 10 mulkon ke wufud shirkat karenge

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum 2026 Islamabad mein mukammal ho gaya — Information Minister Attaullah Tarar ke mutabiq 60 se zyada mulkon ke shurka ne hissa liya aur 13 agreements aur MoUs sign hue. Forum mein National Minerals Data Centre aur Geological Survey of Pakistan ka GeoPortal bhi launch hua. PM Shehbaz Sharif aur Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir ne forum conclude kiya; copper, gold, lithium aur Reko Diq par khaas tawajjo rahi.
pakistan.title: Minerals Investment Forum khatam — 13 deals, 60+ mulkon ki shirkat

pakistan.summary: U19 Asia Cup 2026 ke final mein India ne Pakistan ko aik wicket se hara kar record 9th title jeet liya. Pakistan ne 337/9 banaye the — Usman Khan 107, Abdul Qadir 80 — lekin India 254/8 se comeback kar ke aakhri ball par jeet gaya; Mohit Ulva ne 26 balls par naqabil-e-shikast 49 runs banaye. Haar ke baad ex-pacer Tanvir Ahmed ne viral video mein PCB ko tanqeed ka nishana banaya aur kaha 'bezatti ho gayi', system India se bohot peeche hai.
pakistan.title: U19 Asia Cup final: India ne aakhri ball par Pakistan ko hara diya — 338 ka target chase

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Stock Exchange mein KSE-100 index ne 13 November ko khatam hone wale hafte mein 2.29% izafa kiya aur 178,000 points ke qareeb band hua. October mein overseas Pakistanis ki remittances 14% barh kar $3.9 billion ho gayi — FY2027 ke pehle 4 mahine mein kul $14.8 billion. Forex reserves $26.8 billion par hain, petrol Rs21 kam ho kar Rs332 per litre, aur auto sales October mein 41% saalana barh kar 24,400 units tak pohunch gayi.
pakistan.title: PSX mein haftawar rally — KSE-100 2.29% up, remittances $3.9bn

pakistan.summary: Baloch National Movement (BNM) ne khabardar kiya hai ke Balochistan ke minerals mein ghair-mulki sarmaya-kari maujooda tanaze ko aur bharha sakti hai — BNM leader ne ise 'aag par tel dalna' qarar diya. Warning Minerals Investment Forum ke baad aayi, jahan Reko Diq aur copper/gold/lithium projects par deals hui. BNM ka kehna hai ke Baloch awam ki 'free, genuine aur collective consent' ke baghair koi mining project qabool nahi, aur unhon ne is koshish ko 'mineral colonialism' kaha.
pakistan.title: BNM ki warning: Balochistan mein ghair-mulki mining sarmaya-kari tanaza bharha sakti hai
